name: Toriko no Chikai ~Nakama no Tame ni Karada o Kakeru Otome no Jingi~
original_name: 虜ノ誓 ～仲間のために身体を賭ける処女の仁義～
source:
Otobe Shizuka is the only child of the Otobe family's previous [i]kumichou[/i]. Succeeding her late parent, she becomes the [i]kumichou[/i] of the family. The family's direction changed drastically during her predecessor's time, running a utility business in the local area, Shizuka inherits this work and has fostered good relationship with the local residents. Although it is undeniable that her presence​ at the school is a bit flamboyant, she does have a few close companions.

Always by her side as an escort, and also her childhood friend, Natatsuka Touko.
The daughter of a renowned magician, despite being her [i]kouhai[/i], she adores her as a magic teacher, Kannagi Kino.
Even though she is a [i]kumichou[/i], she still gets treated kindly by a [i]senpai[/i], Takanezawa Honami.
And, from the ally Yakumo family, the granddaughter of its [i]kumichou[/i] who currently works nearby as a nurse, Yakumo Rio.

Surrounded by such friends, Shizuka leads a peaceful school life, but that peace gradually begins to fade. In the area where she and the others live, for a while, there has been a talk about opening a casino, and there is a rumor that people from the underworld are influencing the discussion between those who oppose and those who support. Admiring the dealers whom she had seen in movies when she was young, Shizuka does not have a bad impression of the casino, but after learning that the lands are being flipped forcefully with the premise of opening a casino, she can no longer remains idle.

To encourage a honest and fair discussion, under her family name, she acts as a mediator, however, her naivety gets swallowed up by the malice of the adults. Shizuka, who places an unreasonable bet reluctantly and loses, in exchange for the peace for the residents, offers her own body. While trying her best to endure, her days of being toyed with by the merciless men continue. However, the malice of men encroaches Shizuka's friends as well.......

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1227977]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
乙部静果是乙部组前任[i]组长[/i]的独生女。父亲去世后，她继承了[i]组长[/i]之位。早在前任组长执掌期间，组里的经营方向就已大幅改变，转而扎根当地，经营为居民排忧解难的便利屋生意。静果也继承了这份事业，与附近居民保持着良好的关系。虽然她在学校里难免显得有些格格不入，但身边仍有几位亲密无间的伙伴。

青梅竹马的刀塚冬子，总是作为护卫陪伴在她身旁。
巫希乃是知名魔术师的女儿，虽是[i]学妹[/i]，却让静果视为魔术老师，十分敬重。
高根泽穗波则是即使知道她身为[i]组长[/i]，仍会温柔相待的[i]学姐[/i]。
还有与乙部组交好的耶云组[i]组长[/i]的孙女耶云里绪，如今在附近担任护士。

在这些伙伴的陪伴下，静果过着平静的校园生活。然而，这份安宁渐渐蒙上了阴影。她们居住的地区前些时候开始商议引进赌场，而静果听说，支持派与反对派的交锋背后，似乎有黑社会势力插手。静果从小就憧憬电影里的荷官，因此对赌场本身并无恶感；可当她得知，有人为了引进赌场而强行收购土地时，便再也无法坐视不理。

为了促成公正坦诚的讨论，她以乙部组的名义出面调停，可这份天真却被大人们的恶意吞没。静果被迫接受一场不合理的赌局，最终落败，只得献出自己的身体，换取居民们的安宁。她拼命忍耐着，任由那些冷酷无情的男人摆布。然而，男人们的恶意也开始侵蚀静果的伙伴们……

（译编自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1227977]Getchu[/url]）
